"""A local HTTP server that serves scripted answers per path, for tests without network access."""

import json
import socket
import threading
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reply:
    status: int
    body: bytes


def json_reply(status: int, document: object) -> Reply:
    return Reply(status=status, body=json.dumps(document).encode("utf-8"))


class FakeFeedServer:
    """Serve routes: path -> list of replies, one per request; the last reply repeats."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.routes: dict[str, list[Reply]] = {}
        self.hits: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.release = threading.Event()
        self.slow_paths: set[str] = set()
        server = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self) -> None:
                server.hits[self.path] = server.hits.get(self.path, 0) + 1
                if self.path in server.slow_paths:
                    server.release.wait(timeout=10)
                replies = server.routes[self.path]
                reply = replies[min(server.hits[self.path], len(replies)) - 1]
                self.send_response(reply.status)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(reply.body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(reply.body)

            def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:
                pass

        self.httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)

    def __enter__(self) -> "FakeFeedServer":
        self.thread.start()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        self.release.set()
        self.httpd.shutdown()
        self.httpd.server_close()
        self.thread.join()

    def url(self, path: str) -> str:
        host, port = self.httpd.server_address[:2]
        return f"http://{host}:{port}{path}"

    def total_hits(self) -> int:
        return sum(self.hits.values())


def unused_port_url(path: str) -> str:
    """A URL on a local port nothing listens on."""
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = sock.getsockname()[1]
    return f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}"


def recording_sleep(waits: list[float]) -> Callable[[float], None]:
    return waits.append

cat > tests/test_feedcheck.py <<'EOF'
import io
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stderr
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from feedcheck.cli import EXIT_CONFIG_ERROR, EXIT_HEALTHY, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, main
from feedcheck.config import ConfigError, load_config
from feedcheck.fetch import Answer, NoAnswer, RetryPolicy, fetch
from tests.fake_server import FakeFeedServer, Reply, json_reply, recording_sleep, unused_port_url


def iso_hours_ago(hours: float) -> str:
    return (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(hours=hours)).isoformat()


def config_text(feeds: list[dict[str, object]], timeout: float = 2.0, attempts: int = 3, backoff: float = 0.0) -> str:
    lines = [f"timeout_seconds = {timeout}", f"attempts = {attempts}", f"retry_backoff_seconds = {backoff}"]
    for feed in feeds:
        lines.append("[[feeds]]")
        for key, value in feed.items():
            lines.append(f"{key} = {json.dumps(value)}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


class CliTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.dir = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.config_path = self.dir / "feeds.toml"
        self.report_path = self.dir / "report.json"

    def run_cli(self, text: str) -> tuple[int, dict]:
        self.config_path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        code = main(["--config", str(self.config_path), "--output", str(self.report_path)])
        return code, json.loads(self.report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def feed(self, report: dict, name: str) -> dict:
        return next(entry for entry in report["feeds"] if entry["name"] == name)


class HealthTests(CliTestCase):
    def test_all_healthy_exits_zero_and_reports_every_feed(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/a"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": [{"id": 1}, {"id": 2}]})]
            server.routes["/b"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": []})]
            code, report = self.run_cli(
                config_text([{"name": "a", "url": server.url("/a")}, {"name": "b", "url": server.url("/b")}])
            )
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_HEALTHY)
        self.assertTrue(report["healthy"])
        self.assertEqual([entry["name"] for entry in report["feeds"]], ["a", "b"])
        a = self.feed(report, "a")
        self.assertEqual(a["status"], "healthy")
        self.assertIsNone(a["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(a["items"], 2)
        self.assertIsInstance(a["duration_seconds"], float)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(a["duration_seconds"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.feed(report, "b")["items"], 0)

    def test_unhealthy_bodies(self) -> None:
        cases = {
            "/notjson": Reply(200, b"<html>"),
            "/array": json_reply(200, [1, 2]),
            "/noitems": json_reply(200, {"entries": []}),
            "/itemsdict": json_reply(200, {"items": {}}),
            "/missing": json_reply(404, {"items": []}),
        }
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            for path, reply in cases.items():
                server.routes[path] = [reply]
            code, report = self.run_cli(config_text([{"name": p, "url": server.url(p)} for p in cases]))
            self.assertEqual(server.hits["/missing"], 1, "a 4xx answer is not retried")
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_UNHEALTHY)
        self.assertFalse(report["healthy"])
        for path in cases:
            entry = self.feed(report, path)
            self.assertEqual(entry["status"], "unhealthy", path)
            self.assertTrue(entry["reason"], path)
        self.assertIn("404", self.feed(report, "/missing")["reason"])
        self.assertIn("JSON", self.feed(report, "/notjson")["reason"])

    def test_one_unhealthy_feed_makes_exit_one(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/ok"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": []})]
            server.routes["/bad"] = [Reply(200, b"nope")]
            code, _ = self.run_cli(
                config_text([{"name": "ok", "url": server.url("/ok")}, {"name": "bad", "url": server.url("/bad")}])
            )
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_UNHEALTHY)


class RetryTests(CliTestCase):
    def test_server_error_then_success_is_healthy(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/f"] = [json_reply(503, {}), json_reply(500, {}), json_reply(200, {"items": [{}]})]
            code, report = self.run_cli(config_text([{"name": "f", "url": server.url("/f")}], attempts=3))
            self.assertEqual(server.hits["/f"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_HEALTHY)
        self.assertEqual(self.feed(report, "f")["items"], 1)

    def test_server_error_on_every_attempt_is_unhealthy(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/f"] = [json_reply(502, {})]
            code, report = self.run_cli(config_text([{"name": "f", "url": server.url("/f")}], attempts=2))
            self.assertEqual(server.hits["/f"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_UNHEALTHY)
        self.assertEqual(self.feed(report, "f")["status"], "unhealthy")
        self.assertIn("502", self.feed(report, "f")["reason"])

    def test_no_listener_is_unreachable(self) -> None:
        code, report = self.run_cli(config_text([{"name": "gone", "url": unused_port_url("/f")}], attempts=2))
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_UNHEALTHY)
        entry = self.feed(report, "gone")
        self.assertEqual(entry["status"], "unreachable")
        self.assertTrue(entry["reason"])
        self.assertIsNone(entry["items"])

    def test_timeout_is_unreachable_after_all_attempts(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/slow"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": []})]
            server.slow_paths.add("/slow")
            code, report = self.run_cli(
                config_text([{"name": "slow", "url": server.url("/slow")}], timeout=0.2, attempts=2)
            )
            self.assertEqual(server.hits["/slow"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_UNHEALTHY)
        self.assertEqual(self.feed(report, "slow")["status"], "unreachable")

    def test_waits_grow_between_attempts(self) -> None:
        waits: list[float] = []
        policy = RetryPolicy(timeout_seconds=2.0, attempts=4, retry_backoff_seconds=0.5)
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/f"] = [json_reply(500, {})]
            outcome = fetch(server.url("/f"), policy, recording_sleep(waits))
            self.assertEqual(server.hits["/f"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(outcome, Answer(status=500, body=b""))
        self.assertEqual(waits, [0.5, 1.0, 1.5])

    def test_no_wait_without_retry(self) -> None:
        waits: list[float] = []
        policy = RetryPolicy(timeout_seconds=2.0, attempts=3, retry_backoff_seconds=0.5)
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/f"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": []})]
            fetch(server.url("/f"), policy, recording_sleep(waits))
        self.assertEqual(waits, [])

    def test_unreachable_is_retried(self) -> None:
        waits: list[float] = []
        policy = RetryPolicy(timeout_seconds=2.0, attempts=3, retry_backoff_seconds=0.25)
        outcome = fetch(unused_port_url("/f"), policy, recording_sleep(waits))
        self.assertIsInstance(outcome, NoAnswer)
        self.assertEqual(waits, [0.25, 0.5])


class StalenessTests(CliTestCase):
    def check(self, document: object, max_age_hours: float) -> dict:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/f"] = [json_reply(200, document)]
            _, report = self.run_cli(
                config_text([{"name": "f", "url": server.url("/f"), "max_age_hours": max_age_hours}])
            )
        return self.feed(report, "f")

    def test_fresh_feed_is_healthy(self) -> None:
        entry = self.check({"items": [{"published": iso_hours_ago(30)}, {"published": iso_hours_ago(1)}]}, 24)
        self.assertEqual(entry["status"], "healthy")
        self.assertEqual(entry["items"], 2)

    def test_old_newest_item_is_stale(self) -> None:
        entry = self.check({"items": [{"published": iso_hours_ago(30)}, {"published": iso_hours_ago(25)}]}, 24)
        self.assertEqual(entry["status"], "stale")
        self.assertIn("24", entry["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(entry["items"], 2)

    def test_zulu_suffix_is_accepted(self) -> None:
        published = (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(hours=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
        self.assertEqual(self.check({"items": [{"published": published}]}, 2)["status"], "healthy")

    def test_empty_feed_with_max_age_is_stale(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.check({"items": []}, 24)["status"], "stale")

    def test_bad_published_values_are_unhealthy(self) -> None:
        for items in ([{"title": "x"}], [{"published": "yesterday"}], [{"published": 5}], ["x"],
                      [{"published": "2024-01-01T00:00:00"}]):
            entry = self.check({"items": items}, 24)
            self.assertEqual(entry["status"], "unhealthy", items)
            self.assertTrue(entry["reason"], items)

    def test_without_max_age_published_is_not_checked(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/f"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": [{"published": "1999-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]})]
            code, report = self.run_cli(config_text([{"name": "f", "url": server.url("/f")}]))
        self.assertEqual(code, EXIT_HEALTHY)


class ConfigTests(CliTestCase):
    def assert_config_error(self, text: str | None, expected: str) -> None:
        if text is not None:
            self.config_path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        stderr = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stderr(stderr), self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as raised:
            main(["--config", str(self.config_path), "--output", str(self.report_path)])
        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.code, EXIT_CONFIG_ERROR)
        self.assertIn(expected, stderr.getvalue())
        self.assertFalse(self.report_path.exists())

    def test_missing_file(self) -> None:
        self.assert_config_error(None, "cannot read config file")

    def test_unreadable_file(self) -> None:
        self.config_path.mkdir()
        self.assert_config_error(None, "cannot read config file")

    def test_invalid_toml(self) -> None:
        self.assert_config_error("feeds = [", "not valid TOML")

    def test_invalid_values(self) -> None:
        good_feed = {"name": "a", "url": "http://127.0.0.1/a"}
        cases = [
            ("attempts = 1\nretry_backoff_seconds = 0\n[[feeds]]\nname='a'\nurl='http://x/'\n", "timeout_seconds"),
            (config_text([good_feed], attempts=0), "attempts"),
            (config_text([good_feed], timeout=-1), "timeout_seconds"),
            (config_text([good_feed], backoff=-1), "retry_backoff_seconds"),
            (config_text([]), "feeds"),
            (config_text([{"name": "a"}]), "url"),
            (config_text([{"name": "a", "url": "ftp://x/"}]), "url"),
            (config_text([{"name": "", "url": "http://x/"}]), "name"),
            (config_text([good_feed, good_feed]), "unique"),
            (config_text([{**good_feed, "max_age_hours": 0}]), "max_age_hours"),
            (config_text([{**good_feed, "colour": "red"}]), "colour"),
            ("attempts = true\ntimeout_seconds = 1\nretry_backoff_seconds = 0\n[[feeds]]\nname='a'\nurl='http://x/'\n",
             "attempts"),
        ]
        for text, expected in cases:
            with self.subTest(expected=expected):
                self.assert_config_error(text, expected)

    def test_invalid_config_fetches_nothing(self) -> None:
        with FakeFeedServer() as server:
            server.routes["/a"] = [json_reply(200, {"items": []})]
            text = config_text([{"name": "a", "url": server.url("/a")}, {"name": "b", "url": "nope"}])
            self.assert_config_error(text, "url")
            self.assertEqual(server.total_hits(), 0)

    def test_valid_config_loads(self) -> None:
        self.config_path.write_text(
            config_text([{"name": "a", "url": "https://example.org/a", "max_age_hours": 6}], timeout=3, attempts=2,
                        backoff=0.5),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        config = load_config(self.config_path)
        self.assertEqual(config.timeout_seconds, 3.0)
        self.assertEqual(config.attempts, 2)
        self.assertEqual(config.retry_backoff_seconds, 0.5)
        self.assertEqual(config.feeds[0].max_age_hours, 6.0)
        self.assertIsInstance(load_config, object)
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(ConfigError, Exception))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
